veranderings.voor: het eers baie later met reisigers
veranderings.na: het eers baie later saam met reisigers
veranderings.rede: A name arrives 'saam met' travellers; bare 'met gekom' reads as 'came by means of'.
'dra' is wooden here; 'vertel' is natural and matches the lesson's own image of names telling history.
'gebou uit' calques English 'built from'; a word 'bestaan uit' other words.

veranderings.voor: op die grens van die Vrystaat
veranderings.na: op die grens tussen die Vrystaat
veranderings.rede: A border lies 'tussen' two provinces; 'die grens van ... en ...' is unidiomatic.

veranderings.voor: Eers was dit die Hendrik Verwoerd-dam
veranderings.na: Eers is dit die Hendrik Verwoerd-dam genoem
veranderings.rede: 'Eers was dit die ... dam' says the dam was another dam; the sentence means its name, and 'genoem' matches the lesson's verb without using the avoided 'heet'.

veranderings.voor: met die rivier se ou Khoikhoi-naam
veranderings.na: na die rivier se ou Khoikhoi-naam
veranderings.rede: Named after something takes 'na' in Afrikaans; 'met' leaves the link between the dam's and the river's name loose.

veranderings.voor: Name kan verander soos 'n land verander
veranderings.na: Name kan verander wanneer 'n land verander
veranderings.rede: 'soos' for temporal English 'as' is ambiguous (it reads as 'like'); 'wanneer' is clear at Grade 5.
